name: context-cost-benchmark
description: Measures, with a real tokenizer, the context-window cost of dumping every MCP tool schema into a session vs. a progressive/lazy-disclosure pattern (one small search_tools meta-tool, full schemas loaded only for tools relevant to the current task). Reproduces the mechanism behind the post's '50K token GitHub MCP init cost' and '81% context waste on a 100+ tool server' claims with our own measured numbers.
